Sahil Banerjee
Data Engineer | Whitefield, Bangalore
sahil.banerjee862@example.com | +91 9264501225

Versatile data engineer with strong background in building scalable ETL pipelines, data warehousing, and test automation across cloud platforms. Focused on delivering high-quality, production-ready data products using SQL, Python, and modern data stacks while collaborating in Agile teams. Available to join with a 30 days notice period.

Experience

Dream11, Aug 2024 - Present
Data Engineer, Remote
- Designed and implemented BigQuery-based analytical tables to support real-time leaderboards, reducing query latency by 45% and lowering daily query costs through partitioning and clustering.
- Built SQL-driven ETL jobs orchestrated with scheduled workflows to ingest clickstream and transactional data, improving data freshness from 6 hours to under 30 minutes.
- Migrated several legacy Snowflake views to BigQuery-compatible schemas and validated data parity using automated SQL checks, catching and resolving 98% of parity issues during rollout.

GreenGrid, Nov 2023 - Jul 2024
Data Engineer, Hybrid
- Developed PySpark pipelines on AWS to process meter and IoT telemetry at 10M+ rows/day, achieving a 60% improvement in processing time through optimized joins and broadcast strategies.
- Modeled and populated BigQuery datasets for downstream analytics and billing; introduced incremental processing patterns that cut compute costs by ~35% month-over-month.
- Implemented Git-backed CI workflows and unit tests for data pipelines, reducing deployment incidents by 70% and shortening rollback time.

Accenture, Mar 2022 - Oct 2023
Big Data Engineer, Onsite
- Implemented SQL-based data validation frameworks and automated reconciliation reports for client data lakes on AWS, identifying and resolving data quality issues that impacted 3 major reporting streams.
- Built scalable ingestion patterns using AWS services and Spark to standardize disparate client feeds into curated datasets, improving SLA compliance from 80% to 98%.
- Collaborated with stakeholders in Agile ceremonies to prioritize data workstreams and delivered incremental dashboards validated by SQL tests.

Trellis Systems, Oct 2020 - Feb 2022
QA Automation Engineer, Onsite
- Developed Selenium-based Test Automation suites in Python to cover regression scenarios across web applications, increasing automated test coverage by 55%.
- Integrated Test Automation into CI pipelines with Git, reducing manual test cycles and catching 85% of regressions before release.
- Authored Linux-based test runners and monitoring scripts to stabilize flaky tests and improve overall test reliability.

Projects

Real-time Game Analytics Pipeline
- Built a prototype using PySpark and BigQuery to stream game events, implemented SQL aggregations and dashboards to surface KPIs; demo reduced analysis turnaround from hours to minutes.

Automated Data Quality Framework
- Created a lightweight test harness using SQL and Python to assert row counts, null thresholds, and referential integrity across Snowflake and BigQuery environments.

Skills
Languages: Python 3, SQL
Big Data & Processing: Apache Spark, PySpark, BigQuery, Snowflake
Cloud & Tools: AWS, Linux, Git
Quality & Delivery: Selenium, Test Automation, Agile

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore

Notice: 30 days notice period.
